test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the given sentence.

There was enough room in the __spacious__ flat for all of our furniture.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"spacious"** means having **ample space; large in area or extent**. (विशाल)

 
 
• **Example:** The spacious garden allowed the children to run and play freely.
 
 
 
• **"Roomy"** refers to having** plenty of room; spacious**. (कक्षयुक्त)
 
 
• **Example:** The roomy car was perfect for the long family road trip.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the word **'spacious'** can be substituted with **'roomy'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cramped** (संकीर्ण): Feeling or causing someone to feel uncomfortably confined or hemmed in by lack of space.

 
 
• **Example:** The** cramped** apartment made it difficult to move around freely.
 
 
 
• **Tiny** (छोटा): Very small in size.
 
 
• **Example:** The** tiny** house was cozy but lacked sufficient space for a large family.
 
 
 
• **Cozy** (आरामदायक): Giving a feeling of comfort, warmth, and relaxation.
 
 
• **Example:** The **cozy** cabin in the woods was perfect for a weekend getaway.
